cards.name: Hisuian Voltorb
cards.description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.description: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

cards.name: Mew
cards.description: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.description: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

cards.name: Comfey
cards.description: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.description: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

cards.name: Absol
cards.description: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.description: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Latias
cards.description: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Hisuian Goodra
cards.description: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy— it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.description: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.description: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.description: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Paras
cards.description: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.
